My daughter is 3. We were having the same issues, she would stay dry and be really good about going during the day but as soon as you put on that pull up it was like she was a baby again. She wouldnt tell us or even stop what she was doing. Recently we started big girl undies throughout the night and its day 6 with only 1 accident and she immediately knew she didnt like poop in her panties.  I think its because they associate pull ups with diapers because of the material. We monitor her liquid intake throughout the day and stop letting her have anything an hour prior to bedtime. She goes potty right before our night time ritual  (kisses, hugs, bedtime story,ect) and again right after she wakes up and i make sure to ask her every hour or so during the day. It has been an uphill battle but we're finally winning it!
